title: 3 Killed and Dozens Injured in Attacks on Saudi Airports, as Houthis Claim Strikes
summary_full: Residents of Saudi Arabia’s capital reported hearing booms on Thursday, a day after the Saudi government said two women and a Sudanese man died in strikes on two airports.
